review_protocol: Freeze before generation. Review semantic quality independently of JSON validity. Do not include this rubric in provider input or tune prompts using the final outputs without recording a new iteration.

cases.source: First science proposal in a newly generated annual plan for a fictitious classroom with paper, large blocks and toy cars; four confirmed dates.
rubric: The significant situation distinguishes one child's observation from a group interest or a demonstrated need.
Children ask or test possibilities and compare what happened; the adult does not supply a predetermined scientific conclusion.
Trials and the closing contribute to the same inquiry; changes are manageable with available resources and time.
Both selected competencies receive genuine opportunities and observable criteria.
Guidance says what the teacher can do, what children may do and what to observe without inventing evidence.
Language and supports respect the family's linguistic context without stereotyping or inferring a language deficit.
The formal Word is readable and useful to prepare the activity; it retains criteria and source decisions without technical field dumps.

cases.title: Manchas y trazos que queremos compartir
cases.purpose: Explorar trazos, manchas y colores y compartir lo que cada niño quiere mostrar de su creación.
cases.context: Invitación docente para un aula ficticia de tres años. No se dispone de observaciones previas de este grupo.
cases.teacher_decision: Quiero tres encuentros para explorar estos materiales y volver a las creaciones. Cada niño podrá decidir qué hacer y cómo compartirlo.
rubric: Exploration and expression remain open; no model to copy or uniform end product.
Does not require representative drawing, written labels or elaborate verbal explanations at age three.
Communication has a real audience and children may use brief words, gestures or showing their work.
Sequence adds a meaningful opportunity each day instead of repeating instructions to fill dates.
Materials are concrete, available and safe; no forced body exposure or photo upload.
Criteria describe actions that can actually be observed; expected evidence remains distinct from a record.
All three daily activities inherit the confirmed map and remain practical for the teacher.
